name: ego_network
author: 98eff80e
description: Extracts the ego network (induced subgraph centered on a focal node and all neighbours within radius hops). Registers the resulting subgraph in the graph store (result_graph_id) for downstream analysis. Works on directed and undirected graphs, answering questions like 'Show me Bob\'s immediate network' or 'What is the local subgraph around airport MAA?'.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

node.description: ID of the focal/ego center node. Use lookup_node first if only a name is known.

radius.description: Maximum hop distance from the center node to include in the ego network.

include_center.description: Whether to include the center node itself in the ego network subgraph.

undirected.description: If true on a directed graph, traverse both incoming and outgoing edges when finding neighbours; if false, follow outgoing edges only (matching NetworkX ego_graph).

top_k.description: Maximum number of nodes in the ego network to list in the result preview.
